fixtureNotes: Ordinary fixtures open at 90. The unfunded-bootstrap fixture changes cafe from 22 to 5 and opens at 73. The worker-full fixture changes sub from 5 to 999 and opens at 1084; the refund-full fixture changes player from 4 to 998 and also opens at 1084. Each fixture conserves its own initially audited total; overrides are separate test inputs, not game transfers or issuance.
